1//! PDF actions, allowing you to add interactivity to the document.
2//!
3//! PDF has the concept of "actions", which encompass things like navigating to a URL,
4//! opening some file on the system, and so on. The PDF reference defines a whole bunch
5//! of actions, but krilla does not expose nearly all of them, and never will. As of right now,
6//! the only available action is the link action, which allows you to specify a link that
7//! should be opened, when activating the action.
8
9use pdf_writer::types::ActionType;
10use pdf_writer::{Name, Str};
11
12use crate::third_party::krilla::error::KrillaResult;
13use crate::third_party::krilla::interactive::destination::Destination;
14use crate::third_party::krilla::serialize::SerializeContext;
15
16/// A type of action.
17pub enum Action {
18    /// A link action.
19    Link(LinkAction),
20    /// A go-to action.
21    Goto(Destination),
22}
23
24impl Action {
25    pub(crate) fn serialize(&self, sc: &mut SerializeContext, mut action: pdf_writer::writers::Action) -> KrillaResult<()> {
26        match self {
27            Action::Link(link) => {
28                link.serialize(action);
29
30                Ok(())
31            }
32            Action::Goto(dest) => {
33                let dest_entry = action.action_type(ActionType::GoTo).insert(Name(b"D"));
34                dest.serialize(sc, dest_entry)
35            }
36        }
37    }
38}
39
40/// A link action. Will open a link when clicked.
41pub struct LinkAction {
42    uri: String,
43}
44
45impl From<LinkAction> for Action {
46    fn from(value: LinkAction) -> Self {
47        Action::Link(value)
48    }
49}
50
51impl LinkAction {
52    /// Create a new link action that will open a URI when clicked.
53    pub fn new(uri: String) -> Self {
54        Self { uri }
55    }
56}
57
58impl LinkAction {
59    fn serialize(&self, mut action: pdf_writer::writers::Action) {
60        action.action_type(ActionType::Uri).uri(Str(self.uri.as_bytes()));
61    }
62}
